minimal_queries.connection: status index and reused values, separately, mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only=ON
sql: SELECT name,type FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view','index') ORDER BY type,name;
minimal_queries.purpose: Verify real schema without guessing newer table names. Hash pins and any changes stay in a new receipt; do not modify either source.

minimal_queries.sql: SELECT state,COUNT(*) AS n FROM final_status GROUP BY state;
SELECT e.asset,e.state,e.detail,COUNT(DISTINCT e.h) AS contexts FROM event e JOIN final_status f ON f.h=e.h WHERE f.state='not_reconciled' GROUP BY e.asset,e.state,e.detail ORDER BY e.asset,e.detail;
minimal_queries.purpose: Replicate only a small metadata grouping. Prior result is 9,987 Pro events in 20 batches plus 47 Azure_parent events, not mutually exclusive and not a task queue.

minimal_queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT h FROM final_status WHERE state='not_reconciled') SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.h=u.h AND e.asset='Pro') AS has_Pro, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.h=u.h AND e.asset='Azure_parent') AS has_Azure_parent, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.h=u.h AND e.asset='fixed10k') AS has_fixed10k, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.h=u.h) AS has_any_event, COUNT(*) AS contexts FROM u GROUP BY 1,2,3,4;
minimal_queries.purpose: Resolve exact overlaps and eventless/relation-only rows. Do not infer 10,012=unread or assume fixed10k exclusions.

minimal_queries.connection: status index with reused database attached as values_db in read-only mode
minimal_queries.sql: SELECT f.state,COUNT(*) AS contexts FROM final_status f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM values_db.document d WHERE d.h=f.h) GROUP BY f.state;
minimal_queries.purpose: Confirm remaining 10 accepted + 6 saved gap; 10,012 unresolved and 56 protected intentionally also have no attached values. Do not relabel them all as missing output or unread.

minimal_queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.source,e.asset,e.state,e.detail,p.metadata FROM event e JOIN final_status f ON f.h=e.h LEFT JOIN provenance p ON p.sha=e.source WHERE f.state='not_reconciled' ORDER BY e.asset,e.detail;
minimal_queries.visibility: Result stays private in Azure; public output only counts/SHA/content type. Some source values are ledger snapshot hashes rather than cached manifests; use original source_snapshot_sha256.

minimal_queries.sql: SELECT e.h,e.asset,e.state,e.source,e.detail FROM event e JOIN final_status f ON f.h=e.h WHERE f.state='saved_unverified' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM values_db.document d WHERE d.h=f.h) ORDER BY e.h,e.asset;
minimal_queries.visibility: Identities remain private; use to match existing 6-case diagnostic, not infer new keys or parse payloads.

stop_rules.metadata_search_window: Bounded one pass of known unresolved metadata, then persist unresolved reasons; no recursive whole-migration or source-ad traversal.
stop_rules.unchanged_missing_or_held_evidence: Do not retry same query/network configuration or fetch content.
stop_rules.admission: No not_reconciled, missing_carrier, reviewed_unknown, saved_unverified, ambiguous_identity or protected record becomes an inference task merely through accounting.
stop_rules.protection: Preserve historical blocked contexts, do_not_reinfer rows, all 5 later provider-protection overlays and all source-level holds; do not reroute restricted content.
stop_rules.whole_delivery: 500M/future-delivery target retained, but unique ads/contexts/full-field gap cannot be certified by these same old manifests. Additional delivery scope without an observed manifest remains unverified.
stop_rules.budgets: No new model calls, no resources, no paper, no timers; existing stage1 $25 and stage2 $25 are shared historical caps, not replenished by this run.
